title: Agent sends a two-picture edit to Boogu, which takes one image - the reference never reaches the model
description: Put A's furniture/character into angle B: the agent picks rank-1 Boogu 1 run in 3 (2 of 3 on a Boogu+Klein box), sends only B, invents the content from text and says it used A. Fix the notes/guide it reads + pin it in the harness. Brief: brief.md.
